issues: Meaning drift: "PROVINSISULAWESITENGGARA" is "SOUTHEAST SULAWESI PROVINCE" (not "PROVINCE OF SOUTHEAST SULAWESI")
Meaning drift/format: "NOMOR S TAHUN 2022" should be rendered as "NUMBER S OF 2022" (not "NUMBER S YEAR 2022")
Meaning drift/structure: "DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA" is a separate clause and should not be merged into the title line
Omission: the heading includes both "Menimbang" and "Mengingat"; translation only renders "Considering" and does not reflect the original combined heading structure.

Meaning drift: "Pembentukan Produk Hukum Daerah" is translated as "Formulation of Regional Legal Products"; the more accurate legal meaning is "Formation/Establishment of Regional Legal Products" (produk hukum daerah).
Meaning drift: 'Bupati Buton Utara' should be translated as 'Regent of North Buton Regency' (missing 'Regency').
Meaning drift in item 20: 'pendampingan ... guna penguatan diri korban' was translated as 'for the empowerment of victims' (missing 'self-empowerment/strengthening of the victim').
Meaning drift: "gugurnya kandungan" translated as "miscarriage"; more accurate is "termination/loss of pregnancy" in this legal context.
Meaning drift/unnatural rendering: "is caused by" should reflect "is caused because of" (i.e., is due to) and "to a person" should be "in a person" to match "pada seseorang".
Meaning drift: 'pernerasan' (violence/coercion) mistranslated as 'extortion' in item b.
Leftover non-legal text/page marker "-9-" included in the translation.
Leftover Indonesian structural headings not translated ("BAB IV", "Pasal 9")
Leftover page marker "-10-" included in translated legal text (not part of the provision).
Meaning drift/grammar: "obligations of family and Parents" should be "obligations of the family and parents" (family is singular collective in context).
Meaning drift: "as part of family members" is incorrect; should be "as part of the family" (Women and Children are part of the family).
Leftover untranslated Indonesian heading marker "BAB V" should be translated to "CHAPTER V" to keep the English text fully translated.
Meaning drift/terminology: "Police Resort" should be "Resort Police" (i.e., the local Resort Police/Police Resort Office), not a leisure resort.
Meaning drift/terminology: "Regent Regulation" should be "Regent's Regulation" (Peraturan Bupati).
List marker error: item after (h) is rendered as "1." but in the original it is letter "i." (continuation of a–i list).
Meaning drift: "pemulangan" translated as "repatriation"; should be "return" (not necessarily cross-border).
Minor meaning/typo: "Karban" in Indonesian is "Korban"; ensure translated meaning consistently refers to "Victims" (already mostly correct).

Meaning drift: item (e) 'tingkat penyidikan' was translated as 'investigation level' (should be 'investigation/prosecution stage (penyidikan)'); item (i) 'tingkat Penyelidikan' was translated as 'Investigation level' (should be 'inquiry/pre-investigation stage (penyelidikan)')

Meaning drift: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" or "Regulation of the Regent" (not "Regent Regulation" without article is acceptable, but "shall be regulated by Regent Regulation" is ungrammatical and slightly unclear).
Leftover non-substantive page marker "-14-" included in the translated legal text.

Meaning drift: "Peraturan Bupati" should be translated as "Regent Regulation" (a regulation issued by the Regent), not "Regent Regulation" without the article; clarify as "a Regent Regulation" to match the Indonesian meaning of being stipulated by a Regent Regulation.
Leftover non-legal page marker included: "-16-"
Leftover page number/footer "-17-" included; not part of the legal text.
Meaning drift/grammar: missing subject in 'orders the promulgation' (should reflect that the regulation/authority orders promulgation).
Minor transcription issue: 'date' should be 'the date' to match formal meaning; keep original date formatting as-is.
Meaning drift/omission: the regulation number is missing; 'NOMOR TAHUN 2022' should be rendered as 'NUMBER ... OF 2022' (with the number present, or at least not implying it is absent).
Typo/meaning drift: 'UTA.RA' in the regency name is 'UTARA' (North); should be translated from the correct source term.
Meaning drift: incorrect constitutional citation translated as Article 280(1); original is Article 28I(1) of the 1945 Constitution.
Leftover non-legal text/page marker included: "-19-" appears in the translated text. It should be removed.
Scrambled structure/formatting: paragraph labels and content are run together; page marker '-20-' should not be embedded within Paragraph (2) text.
Scrambled structure/formatting: paragraph labels and content run together; page marker "-21-" should not be embedded within Paragraph (2) text.
Meaning drift/omission: in Letter a, "prosedur dipermudah" should be rendered as "procedures are made easier" (not "simplified procedures" as a noun phrase).
Meaning drift: in Letter c, "relatif cukup" means "relatively adequate" (not "relatively sufficient"), and "kalangan mampu" is "those who can afford it" rather than "the privileged".
